text: 1d Edited Join us at Notion! Some of the most important moments in someone’s career run through People Ops: the offer, the first day, the leave, the goodbye. When it’s working, you start on a Monday and your laptop just turns on. Your leave gets approved without a chase. Your paycheck is right. Somebody built all of that, and it took a lot of care. We’re hiring a Head of People Operations at Notion to lead that work. You’d build the systems, grow the team, and use agents to take the busy work off people’s plates, while keeping a human in the room for anything that really matters. We also run our own People Ops on Notion, which is a little meta and a lot of fun.
